eps.d: Mandy is dating a famous boxer. Martin is going out with an American girl. Matthew stays at home with his beloved surfboard. They're young, they're bright, they're sexy. So why aren't they happy?
While Mandy dreams of a high-powered career, Martin and Matthew confine their thoughts to another kind of working girl.
Martin decides to change his life by moving out, while Mandy is already bored with her relationship.
Mandy gets the chance of a job in Bermuda and Matthew thinks of some interesting ways for her to pay the back rent.

eps.t: Matthew, a Suitable Case for Treatment
eps.d: Mandy dates Paul Johnson, the famous boxer. Martin dates an American girl. Matthew stays at home with his surfboard.

Driven mad by the noise of live rock music being played upstairs, Matthew forces himself out of the flat to do something about it, and in the process becomes the lead singer in Pro-Active, the rehearsing band.
Mandy decides to give celibacy a go, while Martin finds himself a girlfriend.
Homophobic Matt is introduced to gay Jason with startling results.

eps.t: Double Hard Bastards & Girly Shirt-Lifting Tosspieces
eps.d: Matt's friend Jason helps his agoraphobia. Mandy's suitor Marrco finds out she's not really a virgin.
Is Mandy's celibate period at an end when old flame Stoat shows up? And will Martin lose his virginity at last?
Mandy decides to go back to college.

eps.t: Bruce Willis & Robert DeNiro Holding a Fish
eps.d: In the final episode of the comedy series, Matthew's bravery lands him in hospital and he falls for a red-haired girl who is also a student - two of his pet hates!
Mandy starts a new job and meets a potential sugar daddy in the form of her boss. Meanwhile, Matt has taken up palmistry.
Martin gets a shock when he bumps into Clare, Matthew becomes obsessed with X-rated videos and Mandy has a date.
Matthew decides to join the marines while Mandy and Archie face an embarrassing problem when she discovers that he is a less-than-potent force.
Archie's refined mother and sister come round to dinner, and Clare drops a bombshell.
Matthew falls for his beautiful neighbour, Laura, while Martin decides to consu It a lawyer about the custody of baby Rosie.
The comedy series ends with the dawning of Mandy's wedding day and fraught nerves all round.
